title: Feature Request: Add support for Agent Client Protocol (ACP)
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

Please see https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/6686. Ideally, that ticket should be re-opened and flagged to remain open, as it is one of the most popular feature requests in this project.

### Proposed Solution

Implement the feature, per https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/6686.

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

High - Significant impact on productivity

### Feature Category

MCP server integration

### Use Case Example

_No response_

### Additional Context

https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/6686
author: acmorrow

top_comments.author: acmorrow
top_comments.body:
I'd like to point out that the original issue (#6686) had 1) considerably more detail, and 2) 440 👍 / 114 ❤️ reactions. My ticket here is inferior, and I'd strongly encourage the claude-code developers to reopen the original ticket and mark it somehow to prevent the auto-close bot from closing it again.

- The original ticket is in the top 10 issues of all time, open and closed, per ranking by 👍 .
- The original ticket is in the top 5 issues of all time, open and closed, per ranking by ❤️ .

Y

top_comments.author: MattJustMatt
top_comments.body: ACP support would help us adopt Claude Code in our in-game-engine agent. +1!

top_comments.author: acmorrow
top_comments.body: I'm interested in this feature because I'd like to start using https://github.com/xenodium/agent-shell without needing zed's ACP bridge. That's one too many moving parts in an already complex setup. If claude-code had direct ACP support then integration would be trivial.
